_policy: Dev/held-out per labelled set, derived from what each set already documents; no new labels. A technology held out for a step must not be dev in any set of that step (thresholds are re-fitted on dev per step). `flags` lists where a set falls short of that, and every set without a PyPI technology. `assigned_here` marks a split this file chose because the set documented none.

extraction.source: the gate's DEV 9 / HELD-OUT 6 events (eval/gate/README.md); each item's `split` field
flags: NOT technology-disjoint: Next.js, Prisma and NestJS events are on both sides
NOT document-disjoint: the 9 documents the items cite (6 release notes, 3 upgrade guides) serve dev and held-out items alike, so extraction tuned on dev documents has seen every held-out document

benefit.source: eval/sets/README.md: 50 records each of next, prisma and nestjs
flags: ALL DEV: no held-out technology (a held-out benefit technology is a set to build)

breaking.source: the hill-climb used all 241 as one held-out set against a dev replay; Laravel (85 items, Composer) is the one technology in no other set, so it is the held-out side here
flags: the breaking hill-climb's P4 prompt was written from errors on all 241 items, Laravel included: P4 numbers are in-sample (the pipeline's BREAKING_RUBRIC is P0)
states are synthesised from Slice 2 items, not the pipeline's own requests (states.ts breakingUnits)
no PyPI technology; Laravel is Composer, not npm

within.source: eval/sets/README.md: the guards were tuned on these 83, so it is not independent
flags: 71 of 83 are Next.js: Next.js is dev here but held out in `guides`, so the guides set's Next.js holdout is not clean for step E unless these 71 are dropped from dev

guides.source: eval/sets/README.md: tuned in-sample on Prisma and NestJS; Next.js was held out
flags: pairs exist only where Jev said p >= 0.5: a candidate that finds a SAME pair Jev scored below 0.5 is unscored (recall is bounded by Jev's)
merges plus the pairs near the threshold, selected by Jev's p: same recall bound as `guides`

A.heldout: extraction held-out events (not technology- or document-disjoint)
